description: `replay(@sig, 42)` passes a numeric literal where §51.14 requires an `@`-ref reactive array. E-REPLAY-002 fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §51.14 — the second argument to `replay` is the audit LOG: a reactive array carrying §51.11 transition entries. A non-reactive second argument carries no entries to replay, so the call is rejected rather than replaying an empty or ill-shaped sequence.
